extracted text: From section 2.2 (Synthesis): The BEC-zeotype germanosilicates were synthesized under hydrothermal conditions using N,N,N',N'-Tetra-methylethylenediamine (TMEDA) as an OSDA. In a typical synthesis, 8 mL (35 mmol) of TMEDA and 0.16 g (1 mmol) of GeO2 was added to 4 mL water. The mixture was stirred using a magnetic stirrer until the germanium oxide dissolved. After adding 0.32 mL of tetraethylorthosilicate (TEOS), the mixture was stirred for another 2 h at room temperature to hydrolyze the TEOS, followed by the addition of 0.15 mL of an aqueous HF solution. The molar ratio of the batch composition was 0.5GeO2:1.0Si(OC2H5)4:35TMEDA:72H2O:0.54HF. The final mixture was sealed in a 25 mL Teflon-lined autoclave and heated to 170°C under autogenous pressure for 2 days. The B-substituted BEC-type germanosilicate was synthesized by introducing an appropriate amount of H3BO3 into the reaction gel to obtain the following molar composition: 0.5GeO2:1.0SiO2:35OSDA:2.5HF:83H2O:0.1H3BO3 at 170°C for 3 days.
